author: RATTLEWARRIOR
body:
This summer, I was banned for ddos threats.!i have tried appealing multiple times, with perfect reasons that mods couldn’t believe, so I’m guessing nobody will at this point.

i think I should be unbanned early because:
•i have a team that is active and I might be able to join the upcoming tournament.
•we all know what I said was a joke, even though it doesent matter. It was a kick, but was later changed. 
•I was not hacking and I don’t think [joke] threats are equivalent to flying or bhopping
•I am a donator so that should have some say.i want to use my rank

im not bribing you guys, just stating my point

I’m not allowed to post discussions in the “appeal infractions” category.

love,

miles
